notes.title: Team expansion, revised release date, and a new playtest!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,



First, the exciting stuff: the team at Antediluvian has grown! Join us in welcoming another six members into our covenant. Personal introductions are soon to follow.


We are also preparing to move into our new Stockholm office, of which you will see more on our social channels! This is a huge step forward for us and marks a new chapter for our once tiny indie startup—one that will let us build faster, better, and with more ambition.



As a result of the team expansion and our upcoming office move, we haven’t been able to add new content to the playtest build. But we will be opening up a fresh two-week playtest with our previous build starting June 23rd, lasting until July 7th, so you can play while we settle into our new workspace.



Given our expanded team, we’ve made the decision to postpone the launch from our original September 2025 window to late Q1 or early Q2 of 2026. We believe this extra time will let us fully deliver on the potential you’ve seen in the playtests and create something truly special.



Thanks so much for your patience and support. The community continues to be an incredible motivator for us, and we can’t wait to show you what’s coming next.



We’ll see you in the darkness.
Antediluvian Interactive
